Also check error/resource metrics across adjacent services on the order path (API gateway, pricing, risk, market-data, ledger, and any derivatives-specific service) to see which services are actually failing at the same time versus which are merely downstream collateral. Report onset timestamp, affected service list, and the dominant error signature.

Cast a wide net over changes across ALL services between ~2026-03-03T09:00Z and now: list deployments, config/feature-flag changes, and any infra/shared-component changes (DB, cache, queue, message broker, auth, config service). Include order-service, but do not restrict to it. Report what changed, when, and which services each change touched, flagging anything whose timing could plausibly precede the onset.

Map the actual dependency graph and derivatives-specific path: what does order-service depend on for order placement, which shared components are common to the failing path, and is there a distinct code path/dependency for derivatives orders (vs spot/other) that would explain tickets concentrating on derivatives? Also search historical incidents for prior 500-spikes on order placement or on the affected shared components, noting their root cause and duration.

events.statement: order-service ERROR logs on the order path begin at 2026-03-03T12:12:31Z, 10 minutes before the 12:22 report; 426 ERROR entries matched between 12:12:31Z and 13:58:50Z with only two top patterns, both the same NPE.

Dominant error signature: NullPointerException at MarginCheckValidator.validate(MarginCheckValidator.java:88) with reason 'marginProfile is null', affecting orderType=FNO orders — 224 occurrences of the validator NPE and 202 of the 'order rejected with 500' variant.

order-service error_rate jumped from a stable ~0.2% baseline (11:30–12:05, max 0.32) to 18.49% at the 12:12 bucket and then plateaued: 12:19=18.11, 12:33=18.64, 13:15=18.97, 13:57=18.39, last=18.33 — flat, not rising or recovering.

api-gateway error_rate rose in the same window from 0.2% at 12:00 to 1.79% at 12:08 and stabilized at ~3.4% (12:16–13:52, max 3.66) — far below order-service's ~18.5%, consistent with downstream collateral from failing order calls rather than an independent gateway fault.
market-data-service stayed at baseline throughout: error_rate never exceeded 0.32% (min 0.1, mean 0.21, last 0.11) across 12:00–13:52, so it is not failing alongside order-service.

The report's service names 'pricing-service', 'risk-service', 'ledger-service' and 'derivatives-service' do not exist in monitoring; the known set includes pricing-engine, ledger-db, portfolio-service, payment-service, settlement-service, exchange-gateway, auth-service instead.

events.answer: order-service 500s on POST /v1/orders began at 2026-03-03T12:12:31Z (10 minutes before the 12:22 report) with the error rate jumping from a ~0.2% baseline to ~18.5% and then plateauing flat (~18-19%) through the latest data at 13:57Z — not rising, not recovering. The dominant signature is a NullPointerException in MarginCheckValidator.validate(MarginCheckValidator.java:88) caused by a null marginProfile, occurring on orderType=FNO (derivatives/F&O) orders. Only order-service and api-gateway (small, proportional 5xx) show elevated errors; market-data-service is flat at baseline.

events.statement: Only two deployments occurred in the 09:00–13:59Z window across ALL services: portfolio-service v4.2.1 at 09:36Z (dep-5088, ci-bot, 'bump grpc 1.62 -> 1.63', status live) and order-service v2.14.0 at 12:10Z (dep-5101, r.iyer, 'Refactor order validation; add margin check for F&O orders', changes: 'new MarginCheckValidator in validation chain', 'remove legacy OrderRules.validateMargin()', status live). Neither is recorded as rolled back.

The order-service v2.14.0 deployment at 12:10Z is the only change that touches order-service and it precedes the incident report at 12:22Z by ~12 minutes; it is an F&O (derivatives) order-validation change, matching the reported symptom that failures are 'mostly derivatives orders'.

The only config/feature-flag change in the whole window (scope 'all services') was notification-service key email.batch_size 200 -> 250 at 11:21Z (cfg-2101, config-bot, 'Tune email batching') — unrelated to order placement path.

No config changes were found for shared components ledger-db, kafka or redis-cache, nor for order-service, in 2026-03-01 → 2026-03-03T13:59Z (count 0 for each scope). So there is no config-level evidence of a shared-DB/cache/queue change behind the onset.

order-service dependency map: it calls ledger-db (db), pricing-engine (http), exchange-gateway (http) and produces to kafka (queue-produce); api-gateway calls order-service. ledger-db, redis-cache and kafka are flagged shared=true (used by several services), and pricing-engine reaches market-data-service and redis-cache. exchange-api is external (has_telemetry=false).

Past incidents are leads only: HIST-103 (exchange partner outage → 504 on order submit, dependency_failure), HIST-110 (ledger-db IOPS throttling → slow orders, statement timeouts) and HIST-114 (ledger-db disk full from retained WAL) all involve order-service / its upstream-dependency chain and are plausible precedents for order failures, but none matches a 12:10Z validation-change trigger.

events.statement: order-service's full order-placement dependency closure (depth 2 downstream): it calls ledger-db (kind=db), pricing-engine (http), exchange-gateway (http) and produces to kafka (queue-produce); pricing-engine in turn calls market-data-service (http) and redis-cache (cache), and exchange-gateway calls external exchange-api (has_telemetry=false). No derivatives-specific microservice appears anywhere in the closure — the F&O distinction is internal to order-service code, not a separate dependency.

Shared components on the failing path: ledger-db (postgres), redis-cache (redis) and kafka (kafka) are all flagged shared=true, used by several services; pricing-engine and market-data-service are NOT shared (shared=false). ledger-db and redis-cache are reachable from multiple branches: order-service→ledger-db and portfolio-service→ledger-db (tc-018); redis-cache is used by pricing-engine (tc-017) and by portfolio-service and market-data-service (tc-018).

portfolio-service (the only other service deployed in the window, v4.2.1 at 09:36Z) shares ledger-db and redis-cache with the order path and is itself downstream of api-gateway, so a portfolio/ledger/redis fault could plausibly reach order-service through a shared datastore — a neighbour path that must be ruled out. However, T1 found market-data-service flat at baseline and no shared-component fault appeared in telemetry.

Deployment timeline around onset is confirmed: across all services for 2026-03-01→2026-03-03T12:10Z only two deployments exist — portfolio-service v4.2.1 at 09:36Z (ci-bot, 'bump grpc 1.62 -> 1.63', status live, rolled_back_at null) and order-service v2.14.0 at 12:10Z (r.iyer, 'Refactor order validation; add margin check for F&O orders', changes ['new MarginCheckValidator in validation chain','remove legacy OrderRules.validateMargin()'], status live, rolled_back_at null). Neither is rolled back; the F&O margin-check deployment is the only change touching the failing code path and precedes the 12:12:31Z first error.

Historical precedent search for the current signature (margin/validation NPE, F&O, 500 on order placement) returned NO matching incident: the top hits HIST-110 (ledger-db IOPS throttling → slow orders), HIST-115 (connection-pool misconfiguration, category config_change) and HIST-103 (external exchange outage → 504) are all infrastructure/dependency failures, not validation regressions. The closest deployment-regression precedents in the corpus are HIST-109 (JWT library upgrade changed clock-skew default, resolved by rollback, category bad_deployment) and HIST-101 (bcrypt cost raised in a release, rolled back) — different services and causes.

The derivatives-specific path is not a separate service or dependency: the only F&O/derivatives marker anywhere in the change or dependency data is the order-service v2.14.0 change text 'add margin check for F&O orders' plus the removal of 'legacy OrderRules.validateMargin()'. Combined with T1's error being orderType=FNO with marginProfile null in MarginCheckValidator, the derivatives concentration maps to an in-process validation branch, not to a shared component.

events.answer: order-service's order-placement path depends on ledger-db (db), pricing-engine (http→market-data-service, redis-cache), exchange-gateway (http→external exchange-api) and kafka; of these, ledger-db, redis-cache and kafka are shared components, but no shared-datastore fault is visible in telemetry and the only simultaneous deploy (portfolio-service v4.2.1) shares ledger-db/redis-cache yet has no error signal. There is NO separate derivatives service or dependency — the F&O distinction is purely an in-process code branch, matching the v2.14.0 change 'add margin check for F&O orders' / 'new MarginCheckValidator' deployed 12:10Z, 2 min before first error. Historical search found no past incident with this validation-NPE signature; nearest precedents are deployment regressions resolved by rollback (HIST-109, HIST-101) and infra/dependency failures on the order path (HIST-103/110/115) — all leads only, none matching the current trigger.
